scope: Human explicit instance restart: keep current configuration or adopt the selected current Role revision, with bounded current-Room history recovery
owner: Kernel RoleCatalog, existing immutable Agent configuration revisions and presented message windows; Console is a client
implemented: Default keeps actual instance configuration, including native model/effort overrides; deleted Role does not prevent keep
Adoption CAS checks the original Role ID's current revision; atomic configuration revision, instance snapshot and session generation; immutable Instance ID and retained history
Explicit adoption permits CLI/profile change on the same Host; ordinary configure still refuses cross-CLI changes; workspace, instruction/skill references and memory policy are retained
Live execution and unresolved runtime cleanup refuse all resets; leased/reserved execution additionally refuses configuration adoption
Host/profile-matched successor Offers support CLI upgrades without switching identities
Restored history uses the existing shared 20-event / 64-KiB wake budget, current request first, newest background messages next, with omission counts; includes own earlier replies
Restoration is scoped to current Channel or current private box, without cursor rewind; same-generation native binding plus Host delivery receipt prevents repeated restoration
Console defaults to keep and previews selected name, CLI, model, effort and Prompt; retries freeze selected Role revision, deleted Role offers keep only
Only newly marked explicit reset events enable recovery; historical reset events are not backfilled, so deployment alone cannot restore old context
